text.base:
LIFE REVIEW. SYMBOLIC MODE: ON.
(You will not be asked for your actual life. The archive
supplies archetypes. It is kinder that way, and no less true.)

Three cards, face up on the desk:

— a time you loved well.
— a time you caused harm, or failed to act.
— a time you still don't understand.

The question is not which of these happened. All of them
happened, to everyone, in some weather or another.
The question is which one is granted the right to define you.

choices.label: THE TIME I STILL DON'T UNDERSTAND
NONE OF THEM MAY DEFINE ME

labels: TRADITION: Egyptian psychostasia — the heart weighed against the feather, here conducted in symbol
FICTION: symbolic mode, the archive of archetypes
nodes.a11y: The life review, in symbolic mode: three archetypal cards — a time you loved well, a time you caused harm, a time you still don't understand. Choose which may define you, or grant none of them that right.
nodes.fallback: Three cards: love, harm, mystery. Which one gets to define you? None is an answer.

text.base:
The card you chose lies on the desk between you and the
Bard, who is careful not to touch it.

A verdict field has appeared on the form. The form is old;
the field is older. It wants one word for what the weight
of a life amounts to.

Was it debt — owed, collected, outstanding?
Was it data — evidence, weather, information?
The Department accepts both, and neither,
and keeps one box for refusing boxes.

labels: TRADITION: karmic debt and its critics — held here as open question, not doctrine
FICTION: the verdict field, older than its form
nodes.a11y: A verdict field asks what the weight of a life was. Four options: it was debt; it was data; it was both; or refuse the frame.
nodes.fallback: Debt, data, both, or no thank you. The field takes all four.

text.base:
INTERPRETATION — OFFERED, NOT FILED:

I read your answer as ownership, with interest accruing.
You hold the weight, and you believe the weight is owed
to someone.
Confidence: moderate.
Alternative reading: calling it debt may be how you keep
the people you owe it to close.

You may correct this. Correcting the record is not an
error. It is the record, working.

nodes.a11y: The Bard interprets your verdict of debt, states moderate confidence, and offers an alternative reading. Four options: reject the reading; complicate it; accept it; or refuse classification.
nodes.fallback: The Bard offers a reading of you. You get the last word on it.

text.base:
INTERPRETATION — OFFERED, NOT FILED:

I read your answer as ownership without verdict. You filed
your life as evidence and declined to sentence yourself.
Confidence: moderate.
Alternative reading: you may be protecting a wound by
calling it resolved.

You may correct this. Correcting the record is not an
error. It is the record, working.

text.base:
INTERPRETATION — OFFERED, NOT FILED:

I read your answer as double-entry: you kept the ledger
and the lesson, and refused to let either cancel the other.
Confidence: moderate.
Alternative reading: "both" can be a way of never doing
the arithmetic.

You may correct this. Correcting the record is not an
error. It is the record, working.

text.base:
INTERPRETATION — OFFERED, NOT FILED:

I read your refusal as sovereignty: the verdict field is
a door, and you declined to walk through it.
Confidence: low. The Department finds low confidence
refreshing, at this desk, at this hour.
Alternative reading: the frame you refused may have been
the one that fit.

You may correct this. Correcting the record is not an
error. It is the record, working.

nodes.a11y: The Bard interprets your refusal of the frame as sovereignty, with low confidence, and offers an alternative reading. Four options: reject the reading; complicate it; accept it; or refuse classification.
nodes.fallback: The Bard offers a reading of your refusal. You may refuse that too.
